translation: Also, when malaria has already lasted long and entered deeply into the blood aspect, or a malaria mother (nue mu) has formed, use Biejia Jian Wan; if one sets up a decoction formula, activating the blood and freeing the collaterals is sufficient.

Xu Zhongke said, "For young children who have not yet taken grain food and whose malaria has lasted long without stopping, use a strong decoction of rock sugar." I tried it and it was indeed effective.
The condition of dysentery (liji) was called "stagnant discharge" (zhixia) in ancient times, because there must be stagnation and turbidity within before it discharges below.
